dedupe_keys.name: fishing vessel energy audit time series

description: The CNR fisheries energy research team publishes processed vessel-trip observations for evaluating fishing energy demand and emissions. The own deposit describes 15 fields linking sailing, fish-searching and towing activities with energy use and fuel-related greenhouse-gas emissions. One-second raw records were cleaned and averaged to ten-second intervals before export to the published CSV. A field-definition table is provided separately as PDF documentation. The 2022 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0; raw records remain available on request from CNR, not in the listed download. These trip observations can calibrate vessel energy simulations and complement aggregate maritime context in data-unctadstat-maritime-transport. A caveat is that the landing page does not enumerate complete trip dates or geographic coverage. Cleaning and averaging also remove some short-duration variation. No CSV or raw vessel record was downloaded, and national fleet representativeness is not assumed.
